name: tilt-card
title: Tilt card
description: A card that tilts towards the mouse in 3D, with layers that float above it. Flat on touch screens and under reduced motion.

props.name: max
props.description: The largest tilt in degrees, reached at the card's edges.

props.name: glare
props.description: A soft glare that follows the pointer.

a11y.text: A plain card with no interactive parts of its own. The glare span is aria-hidden.
The tilt follows a mouse only. Under reduced motion the card stays flat, the depth layers and transitions are off, and the glare is hidden.
